title: ObjectTwin: Training-Free Asset Verification for Captured Scenes
subtitle: Capture-conditioned asset verification from partial observations
abstract: ObjectTwin is a training-free framework for capture-conditioned asset verification. It checks observed surfaces and known free space across compatible alignments, separates relative choice from absolute quality, and evaluates fixed decisions using held-out observations. The public arXiv manuscript is v1; the expanded v2 is in preparation.
humanInLoopNote: Recorded human yaw edits belong to the interactive workflow archive. They do not enter the frozen-view representation comparisons.

table_legend.overview: We take the same Replica office2 scene and the same Tripo meshes, but change only the automatic compose / yaw / layout algorithm. Each row is one published or in-house method; numbers measure how far its final instance poses drift from our best automatic baseline.
how_to: Pick a method chip below (start with baseline ★ gt_obb_pca).
Watch the 3D orbit video — qualitative layout & orientation.
Read the method card: what it does, paper/repo source, pipeline script.
Open the Δ table: per-instance difference vs baseline (method − gt_obb_pca).
Optional: expand Absolute poses for raw x,y,z,yaw,scale values.

categories.baseline: Reference layouts: GT scan alignment (★ gt_obb_pca) and weak Tripo/COLMAP layout.
categories.yaw: Same translation/scale as baseline; only yaw estimation changes (replica_compose_experiments matrix).
categories.layout: External or full pipelines: FoundationPose, CAST, LayoutVLM, HYBRID, closed-loop refine.
categories.finetune: Compose policy stacks (E0–E5) on gt_pca — preview PNG only, no composed GLB orbit.

interpretation.dyaw_deg: |Δyaw| > 10° → visible orientation change; primary metric for yaw ablations.
interpretation.dx_dz: Floor-plane shift in meters; |Δ| > 0.05 m → layout moved on X/Z.
interpretation.zero: All Δ ≈ 0 → method agrees with baseline on that instance.

columns.instance_id: Furniture instance ID in Replica office2 (same IDs for every method).
columns.dyaw_deg: Yaw change in degrees: method − baseline. CCW about vertical +Y (bird's-eye). +15 = turned 15° left vs baseline.
columns.dscale: Uniform scale change: method − baseline. +0.05 = 5% larger.
columns.dx: East–west shift (m) in Replica world frame: method − baseline.
columns.dz: North–south shift (m) in Replica world frame: method − baseline.

table_legend.absolute_title: Absolute poses for this method (Replica world frame, Y-up)

absolute_columns.scale: Uniform mesh scale factor at compose time
absolute_columns.layout_pose_source: Tag in fp_manifest recording which sub-pipeline set this pose

table_legend.baseline_note: ★ Baseline gt_obb_pca = scan centroid + OBB footprint + PCA yaw (fp_manifest_gt_pca_fix.json). Sim-Ready best automatic compose. Every Δ row = selected method minus this baseline.
